<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/dashboard.ts -->
<!--
  A panel with a chart of one series: vertical bars with captions, or meter rows with a percent. Axes: chart
  (bars, meters), size (default, compact), tone (default, muted).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Point } from "./chart-panel.types";

export type ChartPanelProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  text: string;
  series: Point[];
  summary: string;
  percent: string;
  chart?: "bars" | "meters";
  size?: "default" | "compact";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Container from "../primitives/container/container.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import BarChart from "../components/bar-chart.vue";
import MeterRow from "../components/meter-row.vue";
import Panel from "../components/panel.vue";
import { tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  text,
  series,
  summary,
  percent,
  chart = "bars",
  size = "default",
  tone = "default",
} = defineProps<ChartPanelProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4 py-8" data-slot="container">
    <Panel :title="title" :description="text" :id="id" :class="(((tone as string) === 'muted') ? 'bg-muted' : '')">
      <BarChart
        v-if="((chart as string) === 'bars')"
        :bars="series"
        :label="summary"
        :height="(((size as string) === 'compact') ? 96 : 176)"
      />
      <Stack v-else :gap="(((size as string) === 'compact') ? '0' : '2')" align="stretch" data-testid="items">
        <MeterRow
          v-for="s in series"
          :key="s.id"
          :label="s.label"
          :value="s.value"
          :caption="tpl(percent, s.value)"
        />
      </Stack>
    </Panel>
  </Container>
</template>
